confirm.lockBody: A locked period accepts closing adjustments only. Ordinary journals dated inside it will be rejected.

confirm.rebuildBody: The frozen balances are recomputed from the posted entries. Reports covering this period will change if they had drifted.
confirm.closeYearBody: The closing journal is posted, every profit and loss account is zeroed into retained earnings, and the year is marked closed. This is the last accounting action of the year.

openingBalance.subtitle: Brings an existing set of books onto this system as its opening position.

openingBalance.scopeBody: Open customer invoices and supplier bills can also be imported by this endpoint, but not from this screen — each row needs a client or supplier chosen individually. Because the migration runs only once, importing the trial balance now means those documents cannot be added later without reversing it.

taxCodes.title: Tax
taxCodes.description: A tax code's rate never changes — for a new rate, create a new code and make it the default. "No tax" is a sales code at 0%.
taxCodes.noDefault: No default sales tax is set, so client invoices can't be raised. Make an active sales code the default.
taxCodes.countLabel: {count, plural, =0 {No tax codes} one {# tax code} other {# tax codes}}
taxCodes.emptyHint: Create a sales tax code and make it the default before raising client invoices.
taxCodes.readOnlyNote: Only Finance can change tax codes.

invoiceSettings.title: Invoice settings
invoiceSettings.description: What every client invoice PDF prints besides the invoice itself: the bank accounts clients can pay into, the notes and the authorised signatory.
invoiceSettings.frozenNotice: Invoices take these settings when they are raised and again when they are issued. A PDF already generated never changes.
invoiceSettings.readOnly: Only Finance (manage accounting) can change these settings.
invoiceSettings.loadFailed: Could not load the invoice settings.
invoiceSettings.saveFailed: Could not save the invoice settings.
invoiceSettings.banksHint: Printed as a table of bank and account number on every invoice, in this order, with the invoice number as the payment reference.
invoiceSettings.noBanks: No bank accounts yet — invoices print without a Bank Account Details table.
invoiceSettings.maxBanks: An invoice prints at most {max} bank accounts.
invoiceSettings.rowIncomplete: Each bank needs both a bank name and an account number.
invoiceSettings.signatoryHint: Printed under the signature line. Left blank, invoices show an empty signature line.
invoiceSettings.notesHint: One note per line; they print as a numbered list.
invoiceSettings.defaultsApply: Left blank, invoices print the standard notes:
